name: Sheila Mary Fraser Porter

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sheila Mary Fraser Porter’s English poems in Kabita Live begin with things noticed on an ordinary journey. In ‘HAWKS’, birds perched on lamp posts prompt close attention to hunting, flight and the quieter company of ducks. A conversational voice moves between description and wonder, finding distinct forms of beauty in the creatures it encounters.

‘AN OBSERVATION’ turns that same attentiveness toward a roadside ditch filled with discarded bags and containers. Its accumulating questions interrupt a familiar route with unease about what people throw away and what others leave unchecked. Read together, the poems contrast delight in living surroundings with dismay at their neglect.
